description: REMI - Itinéraires réguliers du réseau de transport régional is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Itinéraires réguliers du réseau de transport REMI Centre-Val de Loire. Il remplace le jeu de données précédemment publié et supprimé car plus maintenu. Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité, geospatial. Its keywords are mobilité, REMI, transport, interurbain, lignes régulières, déplacements. The portal shows 1,307 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
